import math

def line(label, val, unit="", fmt=",.1f"):
    print(f"{label:<52} {format(val, fmt)}{(' '+unit) if unit else ''}")

# ---------------- 1. IT load & diversity ----------------
IT = 10_000.0  # kW nameplate
u100, u40 = 0.40, 0.85
du100, du40 = 0.72, 0.93   # utilisation of connected
lu100, lu40 = 0.90, 0.97   # PSU loading loss factor (loss depends on load)
# PSU loss model: two-loss (no-load + copper), eta peaks ~50%
def psu_eff(x):
    Pnl, Pcu_fl = 0.018, 0.072   # fraction of rating
    out = x
    loss = Pnl + Pcu_fl * (x/0.5)**2 * 0.25   # copper loss ~ I^2, fl at x=1
    return out/(out+loss)
for x in (0.4,0.5,0.6,0.8,1.0):
    line(f"PSU efficiency @ {x:.0%} of rating", psu_eff(x)*100, "%", ".2f")

def heatload(u_connected, lu):
    it_deliv = IT*u_connected
    loss = it_deliv*(1/lu - 1.0)
    return it_deliv, loss, it_deliv+loss

for tag,(uc,lu) in {"end-of-life(85% conn)":(du40,lu40),"build-out(72% conn)":(du100,lu100)}.items():
    d,l,t = heatload(uc,lu)
    line(f"Total hall heat - {tag}", t, "kW")
    line(f"  (UPS + distribution loss share)", l, "kW", ".1f")

# steady-state design point
P_it   = IT*du40                     # 8,500 kW delivered at rack PDUs
eta_lu = lu40
P_ups  = P_it*(1/0.96 - 1)           # UPS losses
P_pue_extra = 0.0                    # chillers outside hall
H_hall = P_it + P_it*(1/eta_lu-1)    # IT + in-hall power-chain losses
line("Design IT heat at rack PDUs", P_it, "kW")
line("UPS loss (96% online double-conversion)", P_it*(1/0.96-1), "kW", ".1f")

# ---------------- 2. Envelope / lighting / other ----------------
floor_area = 12_000.0   # m2 for 10 MW @ ~840 W/m2 -> we will check density
wall_area  = 3_600.0    # m2 opaque envelope
U_wall, wall_deltaT = 0.35, 12.0    # W/m2K, peak afternoon equivalent
Q_wall = U_wall*wall_area*wall_deltaT/1000.0
roof_area = 9_000.0
U_roof, roof_eq_deltaT = 0.25, 22.0
Q_roof = U_roof*roof_area*roof_eq_deltaT/1000.0
Q_light = floor_area*9.0/1000.0
Q_people = 60*4*134/1000.0   # 60 people, 134 W sensible each (working)
Q_other  = Q_light+Q_people
line("Envelope fabric gain (walls)", Q_wall, "kW", ".2f")
line("Envelope fabric + roof gain total", Q_wall+Q_roof, "kW", ".2f")
line("Lighting + occupancy + misc", Q_other, "kW", ".2f")
Q_parasitic_share = 0.0   # CRAH fans counted with plant

H_total = H_hall + Q_wall+Q_roof+Q_other
line("TOTAL hall sensible design load", H_total, "kW", ".1f")

# ---------------- 3. Heat rejection / condenser ----------------
def chiller_input(kw_w, cop): return kw_w/cop
for cop in (5.0, 5.7, 6.1, 6.5):
    line(f"Chiller power @ COP {cop}", H_total/cop, "kW", ".1f")

Q_cond = H_total + H_total/5.7
line("Condenser water duty (COP 5.7)", Q_cond, "kW", ".1f")
def cond_flow(kw_w, deltaT=5.5):
    cp = 4.186
    return kw_w/(cp*deltaT)*3600.0/1000.0   # m3/h
line("Cond water flow @5.5K", cond_flow(Q_cond), "m3/h", ".0f")
line("Cond water flow @8.3K (towers staged)", cond_flow(Q_cond,8.3), "m3/h", ".0f")
# evaporation / drift / blowdown
def tower_water(kw_w, rangeK=5.5, approach=2.8, wb=29.0):
    evap = cond_flow(kw_w)*1.6/1000.0   # 1.6 m3/h per MW... standard: 1% of circ per 5.6K
    evap = cond_flow(kw_w)*(rangeK/5.6)*0.01
    drift = cond_flow(kw_w)*0.0005*2   # 0.05-0.1% typical low-drift fill -> use 0.005%? 
    drift = cond_flow(kw_w)*0.00005*3
    blow = evap/(6.0-1)                 # 6 cycles of concentration
    return evap, drift, blow, evap+drift+blow
e,d,b,tot = tower_water(Q_cond)
line("Tower evaporation", e, "m3/h", ".1f")
line("Tower drift (0.005% x3? )", d, "m3/h", ".2f")
line("Blowdown @6 cycles", b, "m3/h", ".1f")
line("Total tower makeup", tot, "m3/h", ".1f")
line("Total tower makeup per year @ 4500 h", tot*4500, "m3/yr", ",.0f")

# free cooling / adiabatic
def wb_hours():
    # simple bin model: assume site annual wb distribution
    return None

# ---------------- 4. Air side ----------------
supplyT, returnT = 18.0, 35.0     # C dry-bult typical ASHRAE allowable envelope
dT_air = returnT-supplyT
rho, cp = 1.20, 1.005             # kg/m3, kJ/kgK at ~sea level warm air
m_air = H_total/(cp*dT_air)       # kg/s
V_air = m_air/rho                 # m3/s
line("Air mass flow @18/35C", m_air, "kg/s", ".1f")
line("Air volumetric flow (m3/s)", V_air, "m3/s", ".1f")
line("Air volumetric flow (L/s)", V_air*1000, "L/s", ",.0f")
line("Air volumetric flow (m3/h)", V_air*3600, "m3/h", ",.0f")
# with 25/38 typical cold-aisle
for s,r in ((18,27),(20,30),(22,34)):
    v = H_total/(cp*(r-s))/rho
    line(f"Airflow @ {s}/{r} C supply/return", v*3600, "m3/h", ",.0f")

# CRAH fan power (SFP)
def fan_power(m3s, dp_pa, eta_fan=0.72, eta_motor=0.90):
    return m3s*dp_pa/(eta_fan*eta_motor)/1000.0
for dp in (150,250,350):
    line(f"CRAH fan power, {dp} Pa ext, N+1 units", fan_power(V_air,dp)*1.0, "kW", ".1f")

# ---------------- 5. Pumping ----------------
def pump_power(kw_w, deltaT_ch=6.0, dp_pa=300, eta=0.72):
    q = cond_flow(kw_w, deltaT_ch)/3600.0   # m3/s
    return q*dp_pa/eta/1000.0
line("CHW pump power (300 kPa, 6K)", pump_power(H_total,6.0), "kW", ".1f")
line("CW pump power (250 kPa, 5.5K)", pump_power(Q_cond,5.5,250), "kW", ".1f")

# ---------------- 6. N+1 / 2N arrays ----------------
def array(n_total, n_fail):
    return math.ceil(n_total/( (n_total-n_fail)/n_total )) if False else None
unit = 1500.0
for cap in (1250,1500,2000,2500):
    n = math.ceil(H_total/cap)
    line(f"Chiller count @ {cap} kW units (N)", n, "")
    line(f"  -> N+1 installed", (n+1)*cap, "kW", ",.0f")
    line(f"  -> 2N (two rows of N)", 2*n*cap, "kW", ",.0f")

# ---------------- 7. PUE / water/PUE calcs ----------------
def pue(chw_plant_cop, mech_extra):
    tot = H_total + mech_extra
    return (P_it + mech_extra)/P_it
mech = H_total/5.7 + fan_power(V_air,250) + pump_power(H_total,6.0) + pump_power(Q_cond,5.5,250)
line("Total mech (chillers+CRAH fans+CHW/CW pumps)", mech, "kW", ".1f")
line("pPUE (hall-level, IT at PDU 8.5MW)", (8500+mech)/8500, "", ".3f")
line("pPUE vs metered IT 10MW nameplate-ish", (10000*du40+mech)/(10000*du40), "", ".3f")

# free-cooling energy saving estimate
def fc_savings(annual_hours, wb_below):
    """crude: hours where wet-bulb < 5C -> full free cooling on water side"""
    return None

# ---------------- 8. Water-side psychrometrics for economizer ----------------
# available supply temp from cooling tower = WB + approach + foul margin
for wb in (0,5,10,15,20,25,29):
    line(f"Available CW supply @ WB {wb}C (2.8K approach+1.1K)", wb+3.9, "C", ".1f")

# ---------------- 9. Rack density / area ----------------
for dens in (8,12,15,20,25,30):
    line(f"Hall area for 8.5 MW @ {dens} kW/rack, 10kW..", 8500/dens, "racks", ",.0f")
print()
# check word counts later
EOF
python3 calc.py"}
